died.name: Leo Tolstoy
died.cause: to a station master in whose home he died
died.last_words: But the peasants...how do the peasants die?

born.name: Jean-François de La Harpe
born.desc: French playwright, writer and literary critic
born.cause: his final recorded words, spoken the day before his death
born.last_words: I am grateful to Divine Mercy for having left me sufficient recollection to feel how consoling these prayers are to the dying.

born.name: James Michael Curley
born.cause: to his son while being wheeled out of surgery
born.last_words: I wish to announce the first plank in my campaign for reelection...we're going to have the floors in this goddamned hospital smoothed out!

born.name: Brian Oswald Donn-Byrne
born.cause: prior to dying in auto accident
born.last_words: I think I'll go for a drive before dinner – anyone coming?

born.name: Robert F. Kennedy
born.cause: speaking to medical attendants who lifted him onto a stretcher several minutes after he was fatally shot and lost consciousness shortly thereafter
